{{Top|leg}}
'''Akriva Falls''' was a waterfall that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. It was named after a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], who would fly under the falls to try and evade pursuit.<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
